Verses.9:
And he said, "Go and tell this people:
	'Be ever listening, but never understanding.
	Be ever looking, but never perceiving.
Verses.10:
Make the hearts of this people insensitive,
		their ears dull,
		and their eyes blind.
	So that they will not see with their eyes,
		hear with their ears,
		understand with their hearts,
	and turn and be healed."

Changes: 2024-05-23 - Paul Prins: Initial translation of verses 9-10.
